subject: Embedded demo pod - amenity exception & graphic quantity confirmation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Carla Mendez <carla@eventops.com>, BlueLine Fabrication <ops@bluelinefab.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embedded demo pod - amenity exception & graphic quantity confirmation

Hi team,

Quick note on the Cloud Summit footprint: we were allocated a 10x10 embedded demo pod inside the sponsor island (corner B, adjacent to the main walkway). The space has two constraints we need to resolve before finalizing signage/collateral orders:

- Hanging signage/headroom: the island has a low truss line. We need an amenity exception to attach a 2.5ft blade sign (48" x 12") above the pod for sightline. Event Ops told me this needs a variance/permit.
- Electrical and counter: power comes from a shared island feed; we'll need a dedicated single 20A duplex to run the demo rig and a small under-counter UPS. That may affect our crate sequence.

Ask: can EventOps/BlueLine confirm whether the island variance is feasible and any additional costs? Also confirm recommended graphic quantities — my current plan attached (embedded_pod_v2_floorplan.pdf) calls for:
- 2 printed backer panels (24" x 72")
- 1 blade sign (48" x 12")
- 1 counter wrap (30" x 36")

If BlueLine can provide a production lead time and a quick estimate (including rigging for the blade sign and crate pickup), we can proceed to place art with Creative. I attached artwork specs (graphic_artwork_specs_v3.pdf).

Timeline: we need final sign order by EOD Wednesday (29 May) to hit the printer's slot for week-of delivery.

Thanks — tagging Marissa and Priya for PO/ship coordination.

—
Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0127
From: Carla Mendez <carla@eventops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueLine Fabrication <ops@bluelinefab.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded demo pod - amenity exception & graphic quantity confirmation

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear summary.

We can request an amenity exception for the blade sign, but two notes: 1) the show has a strict maximum projection over aisle width; we need the exact blade dims and mounting plan (proposal from the fabricator) to lodge the variance, and 2) there is typically a $350 variance fee plus a potential overhead charge from the venue for on-site rigging.

Next steps from our side:
- BlueLine or your team to send a mounting diagram and weight spec for the blade sign.
- We will submit the variance request to the venue once we have that and confirm estimated fees.
- If you want, we can reserve an installation slot on the evening before show open for blade rigging (may be subject to an overtime fee).

I reviewed the attached floorplan quickly — the pod looks fine for the counter wrap and two backer panels. If you need a third backer (for a corner-facing panel) call it out now.

Carla
Carla Mendez
Event Operations Manager, EventOps LLC
carla@eventops.com | +1 312 555 9876

Attachment: eventops-variance-checklist.pdf
From: BlueLine Fabrication <ops@bluelinefab.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Carla Mendez <carla@eventops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded demo pod - amenity exception & graphic quantity confirmation

Hi Karthik/Carla/Marissa,

Thanks for the details. BlueLine can produce the items listed. Quick answers and a preliminary quote attached.

What we need from you to finalize the variance submission and the quote:
- Exact blade sign dimensions and center-of-gravity (we can engineer hang points if you confirm 48" x 12").
- Confirmation if the blade will be suspended from truss or wall-mounted to the pod carcass. Suspension from truss requires a certified rigger and a 24–48 hour lead to schedule.
- Shipping preference: we can ship directly to the venue curbside or to our warehouse for a next-day tech pack transfer. Direct to venue increases risk and cost (we itemize below).

Prelim line items (see attached quote_blueline_0528.pdf):
- 2x backer panels, dye-sublimated on 3mm ACM, linen finish — $720
- 1x blade sign, 48x12, double-sided, laminate — $410 (plus install/rigging fee if hung)
- 1x counter wrap, 30x36 stretch fabric — $260
- Estimated rigging/variance support (if applicable) — $350–$900 depending on venue call-out
- Lead time: standard production 4 business days from artwork approval; expedited 2 business days for +30% surcharge.

We attached a mounting sketch for a truss-hung blade. If you go that route, we'll need the truss spec and the point load allowance.

Attachment: quote_blueline_0528.pdf, blueline_hang_sketch.png

Regards,
Samir Patel
Operations Lead, BlueLine Fabrication
ops@bluelinefab.com | +1 503 555 2210

Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded demo pod - amenity exception & graphic quantity confirmation

Thanks everyone — good progress.

On Mon, May 27, 2028 at 9:12 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note on the Cloud Summit footprint: we were allocated a 10x10 embedded demo pod inside the sponsor island (corner B, adjacent to the main walkway). The space has two constraints we need to resolve before finalizing signage/collateral orders:
>
> - Hanging signage/headroom: the island has a low truss line. We need an amenity exception to attach a 2.5ft blade sign (48" x 12") above the pod for sightline. Event Ops told me this needs a variance/permit.
> - Electrical and counter: power comes from a shared island feed; we'll need a dedicated single 20A duplex to run the demo rig and a small under-counter UPS. That may affect our crate sequence.

Decision: move ahead with production but with two adjustments to keep cost and rigging overhead reasonable:
- Reduce backer panels to 2 (keep as-is)
- Replace blade sign with a lofted counter topper (24" x 8") mounted to the counter top rather than truss-hung — this avoids the variance and trims rigging costs.
- Add an outer kiosk wrap (additional 1x, same spec as counter wrap) to improve sightline if blade is removed.

Marissa action items: I'll route a PO to Finance today for the revised quote (using BlueLine's numbers). Priya — please confirm shipping preference: our default is ship-to-BlueLine warehouse with RedLabel transfer to venue, but if timing demands we may need direct-to-venue.

Karthik — please send final counter-top topper dims and confirm artwork handoff ETA (we need files by EOD Thursday to keep the 4-business-day production window).

Approving moving forward on production with expedited 2-day turnaround (+30%) if BlueLine can guarantee Monday delivery window.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Event Producer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 650 555 3344
